title: Jack and the Moon Beyond the Map
synopsis: After the neighborhood map picnic, Jack asks whether a path can lead to the Moon. The friends meet owl engineer Dr. Ada and hear about the distant Star Harbor project and a six-person mission.
continuity_state: Before: The Pine Park map is complete; the four friends and Aunt Jo are home with no existing space program within the established neighborhood. After: Dr. Ada has invited Rex, Gus, Jack, Molly and Aunt Jo to observe the Star Harbor preparation for a future storybook expedition with adult pilot Max. Nothing new has been built in Brook Road.
